summary: Tested Tap-For-Details on the game strip plus the Soloverse box art. Backend: 8 of 8 pytest checks pass for GET /api/games/details. It is public and matches case-insensitive substrings in collections and game_logs. Only logs from the last 365 days count (a 400-day-old log is left out). Owners are merged into one entry per user with a copies list and sorted by name. Recent scores are capped at 10, newest first. q shorter than 2 chars or missing returns 422. Regex special characters are escaped. A query with no match returns an empty result. Frontend: the strip has 40 buttons (20 unique tiles, duplicated). Every tile is an image with none broken. Soloverse uses /games/soloverse.webp (298x320). There is no Mario Kart tile. The dialog opens while logged out on desktop and while logged in as admin on mobile. It shows the title, image, stats, owners and recent scores. King of Tokyo ('king of') shows the admin's 13 copies; Catan shows the seeded TEST user with 3 plays and top score 55 in the correct order. Clicking an owner goes to /u/<id> and closes the dialog. Love Letter shows both empty-state messages. There were no page errors.

minor.issue: A whitespace-only q such as '  ' passes min_length=2. After q.strip() the regex is empty and matches every collection and log in the DB, returning 200 with all owners. Validate the length after stripping and return 422.

ui_bugs.issue: The played_at date is hidden below the sm breakpoint ('hidden ... sm:inline'), so recent scores show no date at 390px. The spec asks for placement, score and date.

issues: Each owner chip lists the category once per copy. The admin's King of Tokyo chip reads 'Board, Board, Board...' 13 times, and Soloverse reads 'Board' 4 times. Show copy titles (e.g. in a tooltip) or a count such as 'Board x13' instead.
On mobile the dialog runs edge to edge (390px wide, no side margin). Consider adding a small margin and rounded corners.

action_items: Reject whitespace-only q in /api/games/details: validate len(q.strip()) >= 2 and return 422
Show the date of each recent score on mobile (shorter format if space is tight)
Merge duplicate category labels in owner chips (e.g. 'Board x13'), or show copy titles
critical_code_review_comments: game_details loads whole user docs ({'_id':0}) when only name and picture are needed. Add a projection so password_hash and email are not pulled from the DB. The response itself does not leak them (verified).
The regex queries on title cannot use an index. This is fine at current data size.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted TEST_gd* users with their collections and logs (pytest teardown), and one TEST_gdui user owning Catan with 3 logs (ui_seed_iter6.py cleanup). Remaining count is 0. The admin's data was read only and not modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -p no:xdist -o addopts='' for test_iteration6_game_details.py. For the UI, seed with 'python ui_seed_iter6.py setup' and remove it with 'cleanup'. Real admin data includes 13 'King of...' and 4 Soloverse collection items; do not modify them.
